atoms.text: Nisha has 6 tacos. Simon has 4 tacos.

atoms.a: Together, how many tacos do Nisha and Simon have?

atoms.text: 7 bees are flying in a field. 5 leave to go back to the hive.

atoms.a: How many bees are still in the field?
atoms.finishSound: There are 2 bees left in the field.

atoms.text: 5 lizards are sleeping in the sun. 1 more lizard joins them.

atoms.a: How many lizards are now sleeping in the sun?
atoms.finishSound: There are now 6 lizards sleeping in the sun.
